api_token.description: API token used to communicate with the Cofide Connect API. Alternatively, can be configured using the `COFIDE_API_TOKEN` environment variable.

connect_url.description: Cofide Connect service URL. Alternatively, can be configured using the `COFIDE_CONNECT_URL` environment variable.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (should only be used for local testing). Alternatively, can be configured using the `COFIDE_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` environment variable.

block.description: This project is the official Terraform provider for Cofide.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect attestation policy binding. Binds an attestation policy to a trust zone, controlling which workloads receive SPIFFE IDs in that zone.

id.description: The ID of the attestation policy.

dns_name_templates.description: The list of DNS name templates for the Kubernetes attestation policy.

key.description: The key of the match expression.

operator.description: The operator for the label match expression. Valid values: `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists`, `DoesNotExist`. `In` and `NotIn` require `values`; `Exists` and `DoesNotExist` must have no `values`.

values.description: The values of the match expression.

match_expressions.description: The list of match expressions for the namespace selector.

match_labels.description: The list of labels to match for the namespace selector.

namespace_selector.description: The configuration of the namespace selector for the Kubernetes attestation policy.

key.description: The key of the match expression.

operator.description: The operator for the label match expression. Valid values: `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists`, `DoesNotExist`. `In` and `NotIn` require `values`; `Exists` and `DoesNotExist` must have no `values`.

values.description: The values of the match expression.

match_expressions.description: The list of match expressions for the pod selector.

match_labels.description: The list of labels to match for the pod selector.

pod_selector.description: The configuration of the pod selector for the Kubernetes attestation policy.

spiffe_id_path_template.description: The SPIFFE ID path template for the Kubernetes attestation policy.

kubernetes.description: The configuration of the Kubernetes attestation policy.

name.description: The name of the attestation policy.

dns_names.description: The list of DNS names for the static attestation policy.

parent_id_path.description: The SPIFFE ID path of the parent node for workloads matching this policy.

type.description: The selector type (e.g. `k8s` for Kubernetes workload selectors).

value.description: The selector value. Format depends on type (e.g. `ns:default` or `sa:my-service-account` for `k8s`).

selectors.description: The list of selectors for the static attestation policy.

spiffe_id_path.description: The SPIFFE ID path assigned to workloads matching this policy (e.g. `ns/default/sa/my-service-account`).

static.description: The configuration of the static attestation policy.

ek_hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the TPM Endorsement Key (EK) certificate, in lowercase hexadecimal format.

selector_values.description: The list of selector values for the TPM node attestation policy.

tpm_node.description: The configuration of the TPM node attestation policy.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect attestation policy. Attestation policies define how workloads are identified and what SPIFFE IDs they receive. Exactly one of `kubernetes`, `static`, or `tpm_node` must be configured.

external_server.description: Whether the SPIRE server runs externally to this cluster. Set to `true` for clusters that delegate to a centralized SPIRE server.

extra_helm_values.description: Additional Helm values for the Cofide SPIRE Helm chart installation, in YAML format. Use `yamlencode()` to generate from a Terraform map.

kubernetes_context.description: The Kubernetes context of the cluster.

oidc_issuer_ca_cert.description: The CA certificate (base64-encoded) to validate the cluster's OIDC issuer URL. Use `base64encode(file(...))` to supply a PEM certificate file.

oidc_issuer_url.description: The OIDC issuer URL of the cluster.

profile.description: The Cofide profile used by the cluster (e.g. `kubernetes`, `istio`). Ensures Cofide SPIRE is configured correctly for the target environment.

allowed_node_label_keys.description: Node label keys that may be used as selectors in this cluster.

allowed_pod_label_keys.description: Pod label keys that may be used as selectors in this cluster.

namespace.description: The namespace of the service account.

service_account_name.description: The name of the service account.

allowed_service_accounts.description: Service accounts whose tokens agents may use to attest nodes in this cluster.

api_server_ca_cert.description: Base64-encoded CA certificate of the cluster's API server.

api_server_proxy_url.description: Proxy URL for the cluster's API server.

api_server_tls_server_name.description: Alternative TLS server name to verify the API server certificate against.

api_server_url.description: URL of the cluster's API server.

enabled.description: Whether to enable the k8s PSAT node attestor plugin with a Connect datasource.

spire_server_audience.description: Audience the SPIRE server uses in the JWT presented to the cluster's API server.

k8s_psat_config.description: Configuration for the k8s PSAT node attestor plugin.

kind.description: The kind of trust provider. Currently only `kubernetes` is supported.

trust_provider.description: The trust provider of the cluster.

trust_zone_id.description: The ID of the associated trust zone.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect cluster. A cluster represents a Kubernetes cluster registered with a trust zone.

action.description: Action to take when all conditions match. One of `ALLOW`, or `DENY`. Defaults to ALLOW when unset.

actor_identity.description: Match conditions on the actor identity of the inbound token.

actor_issuer.description: Match conditions on the issuer of the inbound actor token.

client_id.description: Match conditions on the OAuth client_id presenting the exchange request.

id.description: The ID of the exchange policy.

name.description: The name of the exchange policy.

org_id.description: The ID of the organization. Derived from the trust zone by Cofide Connect.

outbound_scopes.description: Outbound scopes to grant. Only relevant when action is allow.

subject_identity.description: Match conditions on the subject identity of the inbound token.

subject_issuer.description: Match conditions on the issuer of the inbound subject token.

target_audience.description: Match conditions on the requested target audience.

trust_zone_id.description: The ID of the trust zone to which this policy applies. Cannot be changed after creation.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect exchange policy. Exchange policies govern Credex token exchanges within a trust zone by specifying match conditions on inbound tokens and determining whether exchanges are permitted or denied.

remote_trust_zone_id.description: The ID of the associated remote trust zone.

trust_zone_id.description: The ID of the associated trust zone.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect federation. Establishes a trust relationship between two trust zones so their workloads can mutually authenticate.

claim_value.description: The value of the group claim from the identity provider.

group.description: The group principal for the role binding. Exactly one of `user` or `group` must be provided.

id.description: The ID of the role binding.
The ID of the resource to bind the role to.

type.description: The type of the resource to bind the role to. e.g. TrustZone, Cluster

resource.description: The resource for the role binding.

subject.description: The subject identifier of the user (typically an email address or user ID).

user.description: The user principal for the role binding. Exactly one of `user` or `group` must be provided.

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect role binding. Grants a user or group a role on a specific resource. Exactly one of `user` or `group` must be provided.

bundle_endpoint_profile.description: The SPIFFE bundle endpoint profile for this trust zone (`BUNDLE_ENDPOINT_PROFILE_HTTPS_SPIFFE` or `BUNDLE_ENDPOINT_PROFILE_HTTPS_WEB`). Set by Cofide Connect.

bundle_endpoint_url.description: The URL of the SPIFFE bundle endpoint for this trust zone. Set by Cofide Connect.

id.description: The ID of the trust zone.

is_management_zone.description: Whether this is a management trust zone. Cannot be changed after creation.

jwt_issuer.description: The JWT issuer URL for this trust zone. Set by Cofide Connect.

name.description: The name of the trust zone.

trust_domain.description: The SPIFFE trust domain for this trust zone (e.g. `example.cofide.dev`).

block.description: Manages a Cofide Connect trust zone. A trust zone contains a SPIFFE trust domain.

cluster_id.description: The ID of the cluster on which the server should be deployed. Cannot be changed after creation.

audiences.description: Audiences that SPIRE agents in remote clusters can present for node attestation. At least one must be provided if there are remote clusters in the trust zone.

spire_server_spiffe_id_path.description: SPIFFE ID path used in the JWT presented by the SPIRE server to the cluster's API server (e.g. `/ns/spire/sa/spire-server`).

connect_k8s_psat_config.description: Configuration for the k8s PSAT node attestor plugin when using a Connect datasource with remote clusters.

helm_values.description: Additional Helm values for the SPIRE server Helm chart installation, in YAML format. Use `yamlencode()` to generate from a Terraform map.

id.description: The ID of the trust zone server.

kubernetes_namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace in which the server should be deployed. Set by Cofide Connect if not provided. Cannot be changed after creation.

kubernetes_service_account.description: The name of the Kubernetes service account to deploy with the server. Set by Cofide Connect if not provided. Cannot be changed after creation.

org_id.description: The ID of the organization. Derived from the trust zone by Cofide Connect.

last_transition_time.description: The time of the last status transition (RFC3339).

status.description: The status of the trust zone server (e.g. `TRUST_ZONE_SERVER_STATUS_PROVISIONED`).
The current lifecycle status of the trust zone server. Set by Cofide Connect.

trust_zone_id.description: The ID of the trust zone managed by this server. Cannot be changed after creation.
